blocs.texte: Three friends leave messages about their weekends. | Listen and find out who does what.

On Saturday, I get up at half past seven because I help my dad. | We go shopping at twenty to nine. | In the afternoon I play chess with my grandfather. | He usually wins, but I sometimes win too. | I don't play computer games on Saturdays.
Saturday is my favourite day. | I go fishing with my aunt at quarter past eight. | We come home at midday. | Later, I take photos in the garden. | I don't like cycling, but my little sister loves it.

I usually get up at quarter to ten. | I have breakfast, then I read comics. | At half past two I meet my friends to play football. | In the evening I watch a film. | I never go to the cinema on Saturdays because it's too expensive. | On Sundays, all three of us meet at the park at eleven o'clock.

1.consigne: Écoute les messages, puis choisis la bonne réponse.

2.consigne: Écoute la question, puis chaque proposition, et clique sur la bonne réponse.

3.consigne: Choisis la bonne forme dans chaque menu.

4.consigne: Écoute la question et réponds en anglais (un mot ou une phrase).

fiche.consigne: Écoute le texte et note l'essentiel en mots-clés, en anglais si tu peux.
